      "source": [
        "Q.⁠ What components does T5 consist of? Look at the output of print(t5) and answer these questions:\n",
        "\n",
        "a. What is the model's vocabulary size?\n",
        "\n",
        "b. What sizes are d_v and d_k?\n",
        "\n",
        "c. Which activation function does the FFNN use?\n",
        "\n",
        "d. How many attention blocks (layers) does the encoder consist of?\n",
        "\n",
        "e. What does lm_head do?"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "X-AdM6TmXtcl"
      },
      "source": [
        "Sample answer:\n",
        "a. 32128 (from the shape of the Embedding matrix)\n",
        "\n",
        "b. Since we have 8 attention heads, 512/8 = 64 (same for both d_v and d_k)\n",
        "\n",
        "c. ReLU\n",
        "\n",
        "d. 6 attention blocks\n",
        "\n",
        "e. lm_head is a decoding matrix which projects the hidden representations into the vocabulary space of the model"
      ]
    },

        "# Let's start with an explicit example:\n",
        "\n",
        "sentence = \"The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired.\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# tokenize\n",
        "tokens_raw = tokenizer.tokenize(sentence)\n",
        "\n",
        "# add T5's special end of sequence token\n",
        "tokens = tokens_raw + [\"</s>\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# convert tokens to token IDs\n",
        "token_ids = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(tokens)\n",
        "\n",
        "# here's what happened:\n",
        "for x in zip (tokens_raw +[\" \", \" \"], tokens+[\" \", \" \"], token_ids):\n",
        "  print(f\"{x[0]:<8}-->{x[1]:>10}\\t-->{x[2]:>6}\")\n"
      ]
    },

        "Sample answer: On the randomized T5 model, attention is distributed uniformly across tokens without clear patterns. On the other hand, in the encoder of the trained T5 model, some tokens strongly attend to the special token at the end of the sentence. In the decoder of the trained T5 model, many tokens attend to themselves or nearby tokens."
